summaries.text: The initial spec was for part BRK-17, a 60x40x5mm flat plate in PETG with two 4.5mm holes 36mm apart. The final change adjusted the center-to-center distance between the holes to 30mm, and the latest version updated the plate dimensions to 70x50mm.
